description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing client data, including fetching, creating, updating, and deleting clients, with API calls and dispatching actions.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Fetches a client by ID and dispatches the FETCH_CLIENT action.

methods.name: getClientsByUser
methods.description: Fetches clients associated with a user search query and dispatches relevant actions.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new client and dispatches the ADD_NEW_CLIENT action, also shows a success snackbar.

methods.name: updateClient
methods.description: Updates an existing client and dispatches the UPDATE_CLIENT action, shows a success snackbar.

methods.name: deleteClient
methods.description: Deletes a client by ID and dispatches the DELETE_CLIENT action, shows a success snackbar.
